verdict.rationale: Notion's marketing mentions general AI capabilities ('Get answers, instantly—with citations', 'Keep work moving 24/7 with agents') and API access to pages/databases/comments, which could theoretically support an AI drafting a status update from recent workspace activity, but no evidence specifically describes a status-update or activity-summary drafting feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a status-report/update-drafting AI feature, evidence of it synthesizing 'recent activity' across pages/databases, and any hands-on or community confirmation this works as described.
